episode.tagline: Vaccines are a modern miracle. Individual freedom is a value we shoud cherish. We love both!
episode.about: In this episode, Ajay and Amit rave about how beautiful vaccines are -- and ask the thorny question, should the state step in to produce vaccines, & coerce people into getting them? They use the toolkit laid out in the previous two episodes to dig deep into when state coercion is justified. Spoiler alert: most of the time, it's not.
